answer: Burned-bid admission sells each new identity slot in a sealed auction whose winning bid is destroyed, not refunded. Once a funding cluster has won k slots, its next bid must exceed 1.5 times its previous one, so N fake heads cost roughly 1.5^N. Honest newcomers who wander in alone pay the base price once, while a nebula of linked wallets can't afford a sonnet-length list of aliases.
